== English errata comparison sources ==
Decipher narrowed the second option to an opponent’s newly initiated battle or Force drain and stated that opponent’s choice. The first option is unchanged. The later PC face reproduces the same Decipher text.

Decipher, updated 29 January 2002, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/f/ff/Decipher_Glossary_Supplement.pdf#page=6 Glossary Supplement], PDF page 6. Players Committee, June 2017, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/a/a0/PC-Decipher-Errata-June-2017.pdf#page=11 Decipher Errata], PDF page 11. Players Committee, Appendix A, [https://wiki.swccg.com/images/3/3d/SWCCG_2023_AdvancedRulebook.pdf#page=124 2023 Advanced Rulebook], PDF page 124.
